requirement: Run real multi-tab writer failover while one tab freezes, resumes and attempts stale publication.
invariants: Writer A publishes canonical sequence 1 with WriterEpoch 1 from one real Chrome page target.
Chrome applies Page.setWebLifecycleState(frozen) to Writer A and the page observes a real freeze lifecycle event.
A separate same-origin Chrome page target restores the same real OPFS workspace, claims WriterEpoch 2 and publishes canonical sequence 2 while A remains frozen.
Chrome resumes Writer A and the page observes a real resume lifecycle event.
Writer A keeps its post-resume local edit but its original authority is fenced: publication fails OC_STALE_GENERATION with expectedWriterEpoch=1 and currentWriterEpoch=2.
Writer A re-observes manifestWriterEpoch=2 without silently changing its own writerEpoch=1 identity.
A fresh canonical read after the rejected stale publication remains Writer B value B1 at sequence 2 / WriterEpoch 2.
